verses.text: Now Pashhur, Immer pikin, di priest, wey be chief officer for di house of di Lord, hear Jeremiah prophesy dis things.
Den Pashhur strike Jeremiah di prophet, and put am for di stocks wey dey di upper gate of Benjamin, wey dey by di house of di Lord.
E happen on di next day, say Pashhur bring Jeremiah out of di stocks. Den Jeremiah talk to am, “Di Lord no call your name Pashhur, but Terror on Every Side.

Because di Lord talk like dis: ‘See, I go make you terror to yourself, and to all your friends. Dem go fall by di sword of dem enemies, and your eyes go see am. I go give all Judah into di hand of di king of Babylon. E go carry dem captive to Babylon, and go kill dem with di sword.

Moreover I go give all di riches of dis city, and all di gains of am, and all di precious things of am, and all di treasures of di kings of Judah I go give into di hand of dem enemies, wey go plunder dem, and take dem, and carry dem to Babylon.

You, Pashhur, and all wey dwell for your house go go into captivity. You go come to Babylon, and dere you go die, and dere you go dey buried, you and all your friends, to whom you don prophesy falsely.’”
Di Lord, you don deceive me, and I dey deceived. You dey stronger pass me, and you don prevail. I dey ridicule all di day. Everyone dey mock me.
Because as often as I speak, I cry out. I cry, “Violence and destruction!” Because di word of di Lord don become to me reproach and derision all di day.
If I talk, “I no go make mention of am, nor speak any more for im name,” den e dey for my heart like burning fire shut up for my bones. I dey weary with holding am in, and I no fit.

Because I hear di whispering of many, terror on every side. “Denounce am, and we go denounce am!” All my familiar friends dey watch for my fall. “Maybe e go dey deceived, and we go prevail against am, and we go take our revenge on am.”

But di Lord dey with me as dreadful mighty one. Therefore my persecutors go stumble, and dem no go prevail. Dem go dey utterly ashamed, because dem no deal wisely, even with everlasting dishonour wey no go dey forgotten.
But di Lord of Armies, wey try di righteous, wey see di heart and di mind, make I see your vengeance on dem, because to you I don reveal my cause.
Sing to di Lord, praise di Lord, because e don deliver di soul of di needy from di hand of evildoers.
Cursed be di day wey I dey born. Make di day wey my mother bear me no dey blessed.
Cursed be di man wey bring news to my father, saying, “Man child don dey born to you,” making am very glad.
Make dat man be like di cities wey di Lord overthrow without relenting. Make am hear cry for di morning, and shouting at noontide,
because e no kill me from di womb, so that my mother for don be my grave, and her womb always great.
Why I come out of di womb to see labour and sorrow, so that my days go dey consumed with shame?
Di word wey come to Jeremiah from di Lord, when King Zedekiah send to am Pashhur, Malchijah pikin, and Zephaniah di priest, Maaseiah pikin, say,

“Inquire, I beg you, of di Lord for us, because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon dey make war against us. Maybe di Lord go deal with us according to all im wonderful works, so that e go depart from us.”
Den Jeremiah talk to dem, “Dis na wetin una go tell Zedekiah:

‘Di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis: See, I go turn back di weapons of war wey dey una hands, wey una use fight against di king of Babylon and against di Chaldeans wey besiege una outside di walls, and I go gather dem into di middle of dis city.
I myself go fight against una with outstretched hand and with strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
I go strike di inhabitants of dis city, both man and animal. Dem go die of great pestilence.

Afterward,’ talk di Lord, ‘I go deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and im servants, and di people, even dem wey dey left for dis city from di pestilence, from di sword, and from di famine, into di hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into di hand of dem enemies, and into di hand of dem wey seek dem life. E go strike dem with di edge of di sword. E no go spare dem, neither have pity, nor have compassion.’
To dis people you go talk, “Di Lord talk like dis: See, I set before una di way of life and di way of death.
Im wey stay for dis city go die by di sword, and by famine, and by pestilence, but im wey go out and fall to di Chaldeans wey besiege una go live, and im life go be to am for plunder.
Because I don set my face against dis city for evil, and no for good,” talk di Lord. “E go dey given into di hand of di king of Babylon, and e go burn am with fire.”
Concerning di house of di king of Judah, hear di word of di Lord:

‘House of David, di Lord talk like dis: Execute justice for di morning, and deliver am wey dem don rob out of di hand of di oppressor, lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that nobody fit quench am, because of di evil of una doings.
See, I dey against you, inhabitant of di valley, and rock of di plain,’ talk di Lord, ‘una wey talk, “Who go come down against us? Or who go enter our habitations?”
I go punish una according to di fruit of una doings,’ talk di Lord. ‘I go kindle fire for im forest, and e go devour all wey dey round am.’”
Di Lord talk like dis: “Go down to di house of di king of Judah, and speak dis word dere,
and talk, ‘Hear di word of di Lord, king of Judah, wey sit on di throne of David, you, and your servants, and your people wey enter by dis gates.

Di Lord talk like dis: Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver am wey dem don rob out of di hand of di oppressor. No do wrong, no do violence to di foreigner, di fatherless, nor di widow, neither shed innocent blood for dis place.
Because if una do dis thing indeed, den dere go enter in by di gates of dis house kings sitting for David place on im throne, riding in chariots and on horses, e, and im servants, and im people.
But if una no hear dis words, I swear by myself,’ talk di Lord, ‘say dis house go become desolation.’”
Because di Lord talk like dis concerning di house of di king of Judah: “You be Gilead to me, di head of Lebanon. Yet surely I go make you wilderness, cities wey no dey inhabited.
I go prepare destroyers against you, everyone with im weapons. Dem go cut down your choice cedars, and cast dem into di fire.
Many nations go pass by dis city, and dem go talk everyone to im neighbour, ‘Why di Lord don do so to dis great city?’
Den dem go answer, ‘Because dem don forsake di covenant of di Lord dem God, and worship other gods, and serve dem.’”
No weep for di dead, neither bemoan am. But weep bitterly for am wey go away, because e no go return again, nor see im native country.
Because di Lord talk like dis concerning Shallum, Josiah pikin, king of Judah, wey reign instead of Josiah im father, wey go out of dis place: “E no go return dere any more.
But for di place where dem don lead am captive, dere e go die, and e no go see dis land again.
Woe to am wey build im house by unrighteousness, and im chambers by injustice, wey use im neighbour service without wages, and no give am im hire,
wey talk, ‘I go build myself wide house with spacious chambers,’ and cut out windows for am, and e dey ceiled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
You go reign, because you compete for cedar? Your father no eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Den e dey well with am.
E judge di cause of di poor and needy. Den e dey well. No be dis be to know me?” talk di Lord.
“But your eyes and your heart no dey except for your covetousness, and for shedding innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do am.”

Therefore di Lord talk like dis concerning Jehoiakim, Josiah pikin, king of Judah: “Dem no go lament for am, saying, ‘Ah my brother!’ or, ‘Ah sister!’ Dem no go lament for am, saying, ‘Ah lord!’ or, ‘Ah im glory!’
E go dey buried with di burial of donkey, dragged and cast out beyond di gates of Jerusalem.
Go up to Lebanon, and cry, and lift up your voice for Bashan, and cry from Abarim, because all your lovers dey destroyed.
I speak to you for your prosperity, but you talk, ‘I no go hear.’ Dis don be your manner from your youth, say you no obey my voice.
Di wind go eat up all your shepherds, and your lovers go go into captivity. Surely den you go dey ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.
You wey dwell for Lebanon, wey make your nest for di cedars, how gracious you go be when pangs come on you, di pain as of woman for labour!
As I live,” talk di Lord, “though Coniah, Jehoiakim pikin, king of Judah, na di signet on my right hand, yet I go pluck you off from dere.
I go give you into di hand of dem wey seek your life, and into di hand of dem wey you fear, even into di hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into di hand of di Chaldeans.
I go cast you out, and your mother wey bear you, into another country, where una no dey born, and dere una go die.
But to di land wey dem desire to return to, dere dem no go return.”
Dis man Coniah na despised broken vessel? Na vessel wey no dey pleasure? Why dem don cast out, im and im offspring, and dem cast into di land wey dem no know?
Earth, earth, earth, hear di word of di Lord.
Di Lord talk like dis: “Write dis man down as childless, man wey no go prosper for im days, because no one of im offspring go prosper, sitting on di throne of David, and ruling any more for Judah.”
“Woe to di shepherds wey destroy and scatter di sheep of my pasture!” talk di Lord.

Therefore di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis against di shepherds wey feed my people: “Una don scatter my flock, and drive dem away, and no visit dem. See, I go visit upon una di evil of una doings,” talk di Lord.
“I go gather di remnant of my flock out of all di countries where I don drive dem, and I go bring dem again to dem folds. Dem go be fruitful and multiply.
I go set up shepherds over dem wey go feed dem. Dem no go fear any more, nor dey dismayed, neither go dey lacking,” talk di Lord.
“See, di days dey come,” talk di Lord, “wey I go raise to David righteous Branch, and e go reign as king and deal wisely, and go execute justice and righteousness for di land.
For im days Judah go dey saved, and Israel go dwell safely. Dis na im name by which dem go call am: di Lord our righteousness.
Therefore see, di days dey come,” talk di Lord, “wey dem no go again talk, ‘As di Lord live, wey bring up di children of Israel out of di land of Egypt,’
but, ‘As di Lord live, wey bring up and wey lead di offspring of di house of Israel out of di north country, and from all di countries where I don drive dem.’ Dem go dwell for dem own land.”
Concerning di prophets: My heart dey broken within me. All my bones shake. I dey like drunken man, and like man wey wine don overcome, because of di Lord, and because of im holy words.
Because di land full of adulterers. Because of swearing di land mourn. Di pleasant places of di wilderness dey dried up. Dem course dey evil, and dem might no dey right.
“Because both prophet and priest dey profane. Yes, inside my house I don find dem wickedness,” talk di Lord.
“Therefore dem way go be to dem like slippery ways for di darkness. Dem go dey driven on, and fall dere, because I go bring evil on dem, even di year of dem visitation,” talk di Lord.
“I don see folly for di prophets of Samaria. Dem prophesy by Baal, and cause my people Israel to go astray.

For di prophets of Jerusalem also I don see horrible thing. Dem commit adultery, and waka for lies. Dem strengthen also di hands of evildoers, so that none don return from im wickedness. Dem all don become to me like Sodom, and di inhabitants of am like Gomorrah.”

Therefore di Lord of Armies talk like dis concerning di prophets: “See, I go feed dem with wormwood, and make dem drink poisoned water, because from di prophets of Jerusalem profaneness don go out into all di land.”
Di Lord of Armies talk like dis: “No listen to di words of di prophets wey prophesy to una. Dem make una vain. Dem speak di vision of dem own heart, and no from di mouth of di Lord.
Dem continually talk to those wey despise me, ‘Di Lord don talk, “Una go get peace,”’ and to everyone wey waka after di stubbornness of im own heart, dem talk, ‘No evil go come on una.’”
Because who don stand for di council of di Lord, so that e go perceive and hear im word? Who don mark im word, and hear am?
See, di storm of di Lord, even im wrath, don go out, yes, whirling storm. E go burst on di head of di wicked.
Di anger of di Lord no go turn back, until e don executed, and until e don performed di intents of im heart. For di latter days una go understand am perfectly.
“I no send dis prophets, yet dem ran. I no speak to dem, yet dem prophesy.
But if dem don stand for my council, den dem for don cause my people to hear my words, and for don turn dem from dem evil way, and from di evil of dem doings.”
“I be God wey dey near,” talk di Lord, “and no be God wey dey far?
Any fit hide imself in secret places so that I no go see am?” talk di Lord. “I no fill heaven and earth?” talk di Lord.
“I don hear wetin di prophets talk, wey prophesy lies for my name, saying, ‘I don dream! I don dream!’
How long e go dey for di heart of di prophets wey prophesy lies, even di prophets of di deceit of dem own heart,
wey think to cause my people forget my name by dem dreams wey everyone tell im neighbour, as dem fathers don forget my name for Baal?
Di prophet wey get dream, make am tell di dream. Im wey get my word, make am speak my word faithfully. Wetin di straw get to do with di grain?” talk di Lord.
“No be my word like fire?” talk di Lord, “and like hammer wey break di rock in pieces?
Therefore see, I dey against di prophets,” talk di Lord, “wey steal my words everyone from im neighbour.”
“See, I dey against di prophets,” talk di Lord, “wey use dem tongues, and say, ‘Im talk.’”

“See, I dey against dem wey prophesy false dreams,” talk di Lord, “and dey tell dem, and cause my people to go astray by dem lies, and by dem recklessness, yet I no send dem, nor command dem. Dem no profit dis people at all,” talk di Lord.
“When dis people, or di prophet, or priest, ask you, saying, ‘Wetin be di burden of di Lord?’ den you go talk to dem, ‘Wetin burden? I go cast una off,’ talk di Lord.
As for di prophet, and di priest, and di people, wey talk, ‘Di burden of di Lord,’ I go even punish dat man and im house.
Dis na wetin una go talk everyone to im neighbour, and everyone to im brother: ‘Wetin di Lord don answer?’ and, ‘Wetin di Lord don speak?’
Di burden of di Lord una no go mention again, because every man own word go be im burden, because una don pervert di words of di living God, of di Lord of Armies our God.
Dis na wetin you go talk to di prophet: ‘Wetin di Lord don answer you?’ and, ‘Wetin di Lord don speak?’
But if una talk, ‘Di burden of di Lord,’ den di Lord talk like dis: ‘Because una talk dis word, “Di burden of di Lord,” and I don send to una, saying, “Una must no talk, ‘Di burden of di Lord,’”
therefore see, I go utterly forget una, and I go cast una off, and di city wey I give to una and to una fathers, away from my presence.
I go bring everlasting reproach on una, and perpetual shame, wey no go dey forgotten.’”

Di Lord show me, and see, two baskets of figs dey set before di temple of di Lord, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon don carry away captive Jeconiah, Jehoiakim pikin, king of Judah, and di princes of Judah, with di craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and don bring dem to Babylon.
One basket get very good figs, like di figs wey dey first ripe. Di other basket get very bad figs, wey no fit dey eaten, dem too bad.
Den di Lord talk to me, “Wetin you see, Jeremiah?” I talk, “Figs. Di good figs very good, and di bad very bad, wey no fit dey eaten, dem too bad.”
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis: ‘Like dis good figs, so I go regard di captives of Judah, wey I don send out of dis place into di land of di Chaldeans, for good.
Because I go set my eyes on dem for good, and I go bring dem again to dis land. I go build dem, and no pull dem down. I go plant dem, and no pluck dem up.
I go give dem heart to know me, say I be di Lord. Dem go be my people, and I go be dem God, because dem go return to me with dem whole heart.

As di bad figs, wey no fit dey eaten, dem too bad,’ surely di Lord talk like dis, ‘so I go give up Zedekiah di king of Judah, and im princes, and di remnant of Jerusalem, wey remain for dis land, and dem wey dwell for di land of Egypt.
I go deliver dem to be tossed to and fro among all di kingdoms of di earth for dem hurt, to be reproach and proverb, taunt and curse, for all di places where I go drive dem.
I go send di sword, di famine, and di pestilence among dem, until dem dey consumed from off di land wey I give to dem and to dem fathers.’”
Di word wey come to Jeremiah concerning all di people of Judah for di fourth year of Jehoiakim, Josiah pikin, king of Judah (dat na di first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),
wey Jeremiah di prophet speak to all di people of Judah and to all di inhabitants of Jerusalem, say:

From di thirteenth year of Josiah, Amon pikin, king of Judah, even to dis day, dis na di 23rd year, di word of di Lord don come to me, and I don speak to una, rising up early and speaking, but una no listen.
Di Lord don send to una all im servants di prophets, rising up early and sending dem (but una no listen, nor incline una ear to hear),
saying, “Return now everyone from im evil way, and from di evil of una doings, and dwell for di land wey di Lord don give to una and to una fathers, from of old and even forever.
No go after other gods to serve dem, and to worship dem, and no provoke me to anger with di works of una hands, and I no go do una hurt.”
“Yet una no listen to me,” talk di Lord, “so that una go provoke me to anger with di works of una hands to una own hurt.
Therefore di Lord of Armies talk like dis: Because una no hear my words,

see, I go send and take all di families of di north,” talk di Lord, “and Nebuchadnezzar di king of Babylon, my servant, and I go bring dem against dis land, and against di inhabitants of am, and against all dis nations round about. I go utterly destroy dem, and make dem astonishment, and hissing, and perpetual desolations.
Moreover I go take from dem di voice of mirth and di voice of gladness, di voice of di bridegroom and di voice of di bride, di sound of di millstones, and di light of di lamp.
Dis whole land go be desolation, and astonishment. Dis nations go serve di king of Babylon 70 years.
E go happen, when 70 years don complete, I go punish di king of Babylon, and dat nation,” talk di Lord, “for dem iniquity, and di land of di Chaldeans, and I go make am perpetual desolations.
I go bring on dat land all my words wey I don pronounce against am, even all dat dey written for dis book, wey Jeremiah don prophesy against all di nations.
Because many nations and great kings go make bondservants of dem, even of dem. I go recompense dem according to dem deeds, and according to di works of dem hands.”
Because di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis to me: “Take dis cup of di wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all di nations, to whom I send you, to drink am.
Dem go drink, and stagger, and go mad, because of di sword wey I go send among dem.”
Den I take di cup from di Lord hand, and make all di nations drink, to whom di Lord send me:
Jerusalem, and di cities of Judah, and di kings of dem, and di princes of dem, to make dem waste, astonishment, hissing, and curse, as e dey dis day;
Pharaoh king of Egypt, and im servants, and im princes, and all im people;
and all di mixed people, and all di kings of di land of Uz, and all di kings of di land of di Philistines (Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and di remnant of Ashdod);
Edom, Moab, and di children of Ammon;
and all di kings of Tyre, and all di kings of Sidon, and di kings of di islands wey dey beyond di sea;
Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all dem wey dey di corners;
and all di kings of Arabia, and all di kings of di mixed people wey dwell for di wilderness;
and all di kings of Zimri, and all di kings of Elam, and all di kings of di Medes;
and all di kings of di north, far and near, one after another, and all di kingdoms of di world wey dey upon di surface of di earth. Di king of Sheshach go drink after dem.
“You go talk to dem, ‘Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: Drink, and dey drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of di sword wey I go send among una.’
E go be, if dem refuse to take di cup from your hand to drink, den you go talk to dem, ‘Di Lord of Armies talk like dis: Una must drink.

Because see, I don begin to bring evil for di city wey dem call by my name, and una go go unpunished? Una no go go unpunished, because I go call for sword on all di inhabitants of di earth,’ talk di Lord of Armies.”

“Therefore prophesy against dem all dis words, and talk to dem, ‘Di Lord go roar from on high, and utter im voice from im holy habitation. E go mightily roar against im fold. E go give shout, as dem wey tread di grapes, against all di inhabitants of di earth.
Di noise go come even to di end of di earth, because di Lord get controversy with di nations. E go enter into judgment with all flesh. As for di wicked, e go give dem to di sword,’ talk di Lord.”
Di Lord of Armies talk like dis: “See, evil go go out from nation to nation, and great storm go dey stirred up from di uttermost parts of di earth.
Dem wey di Lord don kill for dat day go dey from one end of di earth even to di other end of di earth. Dem no go dey lamented, neither gathered, nor buried. Dem go be dung on di surface of di ground.
Howl, una shepherds, and cry. Wallow for ashes, una principal of di flock, because di days of una slaughter and of una scattering don complete, and una go fall like pleasant vessel.
Di shepherds go get no way to flee, nor di principal of di flock to escape.
Hear di sound of di cry of di shepherds, and di howling of di principal of di flock, because di Lord dey destroy dem pasture.
Di peaceful folds dey cut down because of di fierce anger of di Lord.
E don leave im covert, like di lion, because dem land don become desolation because of di fierceness of di oppressing sword, and because of im fierce anger.”
For di beginning of di reign of Jehoiakim, Josiah pikin, king of Judah, dis word come from di Lord, say,

“Di Lord talk like dis: Stand for di court of di Lord house, and speak to all di cities of Judah, wey come to worship for di Lord house, all di words wey I command you to speak to dem. No diminish one word.
Maybe dem go listen, and turn everyone from im evil way, so that I go relent of di evil, wey I purpose to do to dem because of di evil of dem doings.
You go talk to dem, ‘Di Lord talk like dis: If una no listen to me, to waka for my law, wey I don set before una,
to listen to di words of my servants di prophets, wey I send to una, even rising up early and sending dem (but una no listen),
den I go make dis house like Shiloh, and I go make dis city curse to all di nations of di earth.’”
Di priests and di prophets and all di people hear Jeremiah speaking dis words for di house of di Lord.
E happen, when Jeremiah don finish speaking all wey di Lord command am to speak to all di people, say di priests and di prophets and all di people seize am, saying, “You must surely die.
Why you don prophesy for di name of di Lord, saying, ‘Dis house go be like Shiloh, and dis city go dey desolate, without inhabitant’?” All di people gather against Jeremiah for di house of di Lord.
When di princes of Judah hear dis things, dem come up from di king house to di house of di Lord, and sit for di entry of di new gate of di Lord house.
Den di priests and di prophets talk to di princes and to all di people, saying, “Dis man deserve sentence of death, because e don prophesy against dis city, as una don hear with una ears.”
Den Jeremiah speak to all di princes and to all di people, saying, “Di Lord send me to prophesy against dis house and against dis city all di words wey una don hear.
Therefore now amend una ways and una doings, and obey di voice of di Lord una God, and di Lord go relent of di evil wey e don pronounce against una.
But as for me, see, I dey in una hand. Do with me as e dey good and right for una eyes.

Only know for certain say if una put me to death, una go bring innocent blood on yourselves, and on dis city, and on di inhabitants of am, because truly di Lord don send me to una to speak all dis words for una ears.”
Den di princes and all di people talk to di priests and to di prophets, “Dis man no deserve sentence of death, because e don speak to us for di name of di Lord our God.”
Den some of di elders of di land rise up, and speak to all di assembly of di people, saying,

“Micah di Morashtite prophesy for di days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and e talk to all di people of Judah, saying, ‘Di Lord of Armies talk like dis: Zion go dey plowed like field, and Jerusalem go become heaps, and di mountain of di house go be like di high places of di forest.’

Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put am to death at all? E no fear di Lord, and entreat di favour of di Lord, and di Lord relent of di evil wey e don pronounce against dem? Dis way we go commit great evil against our own souls.”
Dere dey also man wey prophesy for di name of di Lord, Uriah, Shemaiah pikin of Kiriath Jearim. E prophesy against dis city and against dis land according to all di words of Jeremiah.
When Jehoiakim di king, with all im mighty men and all di princes, hear im words, di king seek to put am to death. But when Uriah hear am, e fear, and flee, and go to Egypt.
Jehoiakim di king send men into Egypt: Elnathan, Achbor pikin, and some men with am into Egypt.
Dem fetch Uriah out of Egypt, and bring am to Jehoiakim di king, who kill am with di sword, and cast im dead body into di graves of di common people.
But di hand of Ahikam, Shaphan pikin, dey with Jeremiah, so that dem no give am into di hand of di people to put am to death.
For di beginning of di reign of Jehoiakim, Josiah pikin, king of Judah, dis word come to Jeremiah from di Lord, say,
“Di Lord talk like dis to me: Make bonds and yokes for yourself, and put dem on your neck,

and send am to di king of Edom, and to di king of Moab, and to di king of di children of Ammon, and to di king of Tyre, and to di king of Sidon, by di hand of di messengers wey come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
Command dem to talk to dem masters, ‘Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: Una go talk to una masters dis:
I don make di earth, di man and di animals wey dey upon di surface of di earth, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and I give am to whom e seem right to me.
Now I don give all dis lands into di hand of Nebuchadnezzar di king of Babylon, my servant. I don also give di animals of di field to am to serve am.
All di nations go serve am, and im son, and im son son, until di time of im own land come. Den many nations and great kings go make am serve dem.

E go happen, say di nation and kingdom wey no go serve di same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and wey no go put dem neck under di yoke of di king of Babylon, dat nation I go punish,’ talk di Lord, ‘with di sword, and with famine, and with pestilence, until I don consume dem by im hand.
But as for una, no listen to una prophets, nor to una diviners, nor to una dreamers, nor to una enchanters, nor to una sorcerers, wey talk to una, saying, “Una no go serve di king of Babylon,”
because dem prophesy lie to una, to remove una far from una land, and so that I go drive una out, and una go perish.
But di nation wey bring dem neck under di yoke of di king of Babylon, and serve am, dat nation I go let remain for dem own land,’ talk di Lord, ‘and dem go till am, and dwell inside am.’”
I speak to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all dis words, saying, “Bring una necks under di yoke of di king of Babylon, and serve am and im people, and live.
Why una go die, you and your people, by di sword, by di famine, and by di pestilence, as di Lord don speak against di nation wey no go serve di king of Babylon?
No listen to di words of di prophets wey speak to una, saying, ‘Una no go serve di king of Babylon,’ because dem prophesy lie to una.
‘Because I never send dem,’ talk di Lord, ‘but dem prophesy falsely for my name, so that I go drive una out, and una go perish, una and di prophets wey prophesy to una.’”

Also I speak to di priests and to all dis people, saying, “Di Lord talk like dis: No listen to di words of una prophets wey prophesy to una, saying, ‘See, di vessels of di Lord house go soon dey brought again from Babylon,’ because dem prophesy lie to una.
No listen to dem. Serve di king of Babylon, and live. Why dis city go become desolate?

But if dem be prophets, and if di word of di Lord dey with dem, make dem now make intercession to di Lord of Armies, so that di vessels wey remain for di house of di Lord, and for di house of di king of Judah, and for Jerusalem no go go to Babylon.
Because di Lord of Armies talk like dis concerning di pillars, and concerning di sea, and concerning di bases, and concerning di residue of di vessels wey remain for dis city,
wey Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon no take, when e carry away captive Jeconiah, Jehoiakim pikin, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, with all di nobles of Judah and Jerusalem.
Yes, di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis concerning di vessels wey remain for di house of di Lord, and for di house of di king of Judah, and for Jerusalem:
‘Dem go dey carried to Babylon, and dem go dey dere until di day wey I visit dem,’ talk di Lord. ‘Den I go bring dem up, and restore dem to dis place.’”

E happen for dat same year, for di beginning of di reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, for di fourth year, for di fifth month, Hananiah, Azzur pikin, di prophet, wey dey from Gibeon, speak to me for di house of di Lord, for di presence of di priests and of all di people, saying,
“Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: ‘I don break di yoke of di king of Babylon.
Within two full years I go bring again into dis place all di vessels of di Lord house, wey Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon take away from dis place, and carry to Babylon.
I go bring again to dis place Jeconiah, Jehoiakim pikin, king of Judah, with all di captives of Judah, wey enter Babylon,’ talk di Lord, ‘because I go break di yoke of di king of Babylon.’”
Den di prophet Jeremiah talk to di prophet Hananiah for di presence of di priests, and for di presence of all di people wey stand for di house of di Lord,

even di prophet Jeremiah talk, “Amen! Di Lord do so! Di Lord perform your words wey you don prophesy, to bring again di vessels of di Lord house, and all wey dem carry away captive, from Babylon to dis place.
Nevertheless hear now dis word wey I speak for your ears and for di ears of all di people:
Di prophets wey don dey before me and before you of old prophesy against many countries and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
Di prophet wey prophesy of peace, when di word of di prophet come to pass, den di prophet go dey known, say di Lord truly don send am.”
Den Hananiah di prophet take di yoke from off di prophet Jeremiah neck, and break am.

Hananiah speak for di presence of all di people, saying, “Di Lord talk like dis: ‘Even so I go break di yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off di neck of all di nations within two full years.’” Di prophet Jeremiah go im way.
Den di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah, after Hananiah di prophet don break di yoke from off di neck of di prophet Jeremiah, say,
“Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘Di Lord talk like dis: You don break di yokes of wood, but you don make for dem yokes of iron.

Because di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: I don put yoke of iron on di neck of all dis nations, so that dem go serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. Dem go serve am. I don also give am di animals of di field.’”
Den di prophet Jeremiah talk to Hananiah di prophet, “Hear now, Hananiah! Di Lord no send you, but you make dis people trust for lie.
Therefore di Lord talk like dis: ‘See, I go cast you off from di surface of di earth. Dis year you go die, because you don speak rebellion against di Lord.’”
So Hananiah di prophet die di same year for di seventh month.

Now dis na di words of di letter wey Jeremiah di prophet send from Jerusalem to di remaining elders of di captives, and to di priests, and to di prophets, and to all di people, wey Nebuchadnezzar don carry away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon
(after Jeconiah di king, and di queen mother, and di eunuchs, and di princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and di craftsmen and di smiths, don depart from Jerusalem),
by di hand of Elasah, Shaphan pikin, and Gemariah, Hilkiah pikin (wey Zedekiah king of Judah send to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon), saying,
“Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis to all di captives, wey I don cause to dey carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:
Build houses, and dwell for dem. Plant gardens, and eat dem fruit.
Take wives, and bear sons and daughters. Take wives for una sons, and give una daughters to husbands, so that dem go bear sons and daughters. Multiply dere, and no dey diminished.
Seek di peace of di city where I don cause una to dey carried away captive, and pray to di Lord for am, because for di peace of am una go get peace.
Because di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: No let una prophets wey dey among una, and una diviners, deceive una. No listen to una dreams wey una cause to dey dreamed.
Because dem prophesy falsely to una for my name. I no send dem,” talk di Lord.
“Because di Lord talk like dis: After 70 years dey complete for Babylon, I go visit una, and perform my good word toward una, to cause una to return to dis place.
Because I know di thoughts wey I think toward una,” talk di Lord, “thoughts of peace, and no of evil, to give una future and hope.
Una go call on me, and una go go and pray to me, and I go listen to una.
Una go seek me, and find me, when una search for me with all una heart.

I go dey found by una,” talk di Lord, “and I go turn again una captivity, and gather una from all di nations, and from all di places where I don drive una,” talk di Lord. “I go bring una again to di place from where I cause una to dey carried away captive.
Because una don talk, ‘Di Lord don raise up prophets for us for Babylon.’
Know say di Lord talk like dis concerning di king wey sit on di throne of David, and concerning all di people wey dwell for dis city, concerning una brothers wey no go forth with una into captivity:
‘Di Lord of Armies talk like dis: See, I go send on dem di sword, di famine and di pestilence, and I go make dem like vile figs, wey no fit dey eaten, dem too bad.

I go pursue dem with di sword, with famine and with pestilence, and I go cause dem to dey tossed to and fro among all di kingdoms of di earth, to be curse, and astonishment, and hissing, and reproach, among all di nations where I don drive dem,
because dem no listen to my words,’ talk di Lord, ‘wey I send to dem by my servants di prophets, rising up early and sending dem. But una no listen,’ talk di Lord.
Hear di word of di Lord, all una of di captivity, wey I don send away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis concerning Ahab, Kolaiah pikin, and concerning Zedekiah, Maaseiah pikin, wey prophesy lie to una for my name: See, I go deliver dem into di hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and e go kill dem before una eyes.
From dem go dey taken up curse by all di captives of Judah wey dey Babylon, say, ‘Di Lord make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, wey di king of Babylon roast for di fire,’

because dem don work folly for Israel, and don commit adultery with dem neighbours wives, and don speak lying words for my name, wey I no command dem. I be im wey know, and I be witness,” talk di Lord.
Concerning Shemaiah di Nehelamite you go speak, saying,

“Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis, saying, Because you don send letters for your own name to all di people wey dey Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah, Maaseiah pikin, di priest, and to all di priests, saying,

‘Di Lord don make you priest instead of Jehoiada di priest, so that una go be officers for di house of di Lord, over every man wey dey mad and make imself prophet, so that you go put am for di stocks and for di collar.
Now therefore why you no rebuke Jeremiah of Anathoth, wey make imself prophet to una,
because e don send to us for Babylon, saying, “Di captivity go long. Build houses, and dwell for dem. Plant gardens, and eat dem fruit”?’”
Zephaniah di priest read dis letter for di ears of Jeremiah di prophet.
Den di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah, say,
“Send to all dem for di captivity, saying, ‘Di Lord talk like dis concerning Shemaiah di Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah don prophesy to una, and I no send am, and e cause una to trust for lie,’

therefore di Lord talk like dis: ‘See, I go punish Shemaiah di Nehelamite, and im offspring. E no go get man to dwell among dis people, neither e go see di good wey I go do for my people,’ talk di Lord, ‘because e don speak rebellion against di Lord.’”
